title: Wind and Truth
author: Brandon Sanderson
summary: The fifth and final book of the first arc of the Stormlight Archive, a huge fantasy series. It gathers storylines about a war with an ancient enemy and the characters' oaths into the long-awaited climax of this half of the story.
readIf: you've been reading the series and want the big payoff, with all its threads and characters in play.
skipIf: you haven't read the earlier books, since this assumes all of them.

pairings.reason: Another long, absorbing fantasy where the pleasure is in its voice and magic, although self-contained in focus.
The great model of an epic finale, where a long war and many threads come to a head.
Same author, with a tighter and shorter story to see the same style of magic and payoff.
